 BLACKPINK reaches the milestone of over 100 million views for the 16th time.
 BLACKPINK's 'GO' becomes the group's 16th music video to surpass 100 million views.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 05/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 BLACKPINK's music video for "GO" has surpassed 100 million views. This means it took approximately 8 months and 8 days from the time the music video was released at 2 PM on February 27, 2026 ( Korean time) to reach that milestone. 
 You may also like GO is BLACKPINK's 16th music video (with all members) to reach 100 million views on YouTube, following the songs: BOOMBAYAH, Playing with Fire, Whistle, As If It's Your Last, Stay, DDU-DU DDU-DU, Kill This Love, How You Like That, Ice Cream, Lovesick Girls, Pink Venom, Shut Down, Ready For Love, THE GIRLS , and JUMP . 
 Meanwhile, YG Entertainment (BLACKPINK's management company) is simultaneously preparing new male and female groups while maintaining BLACKPINK's group activities. Since the individual activities of BLACKPINK members are not covered by their exclusive contracts, the areas from which YG can directly generate revenue through BLACKPINK's IP have narrowed to only group projects. The company is in a position where it must expand its revenue base by promoting new music IPs while simultaneously increasing profits from group activities.
 You may also like BLACKPINK resumed full group activities in July 2025 with the launch of their DEADLINE world tour. That same year, YG Entertainment's consolidated concert revenue increased by approximately 644%, from 17 billion won in 2024 to 126.4 billion won in 2025. However, this figure includes performances by other artists, such as TREASURE and BABY MONSTER. While BLACKPINK's group activities contributed to the revenue expansion, it is difficult to determine the actual profit earned based solely on the published figures.
